caption: The drawing consists of a square-shaped object resembling a textile or woven pattern, centrally positioned on a light beige background. The center of the composition features a large, plain square in a muted beige color. Surrounding this are alternating rectangular and square bands with intricate cross-hatch and checkered patterns in muted dark blue, gray, cream, and beige tones. The outermost edge displays a repeated grid and diagonal line pattern in dark blue and beige, forming a prominent border. The intersecting bands create a symmetrical plaid-like effect that radiates outward from the central plain square, with notable contrast between the lighter and darker sections. No other objects or elements are present within the drawing.
